overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on creating a French moral reasoning dataset through machine translation and evaluating LLM moral alignment. NLG tasks include translation and moral action selection. Automatic metrics include quality estimation and perplexity-based evaluations. Human evaluation was conducted for translation quality. No LLM-as-judge methodology was used. Extraction was generally good but needed normalization and minor additions.
